snippet.title: SEASON 31 - Game Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Releasing on October 1st.
WISHLIST on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775580/Season_31/

Season 31 is a short narrative experimental indie game about loss, degrowth and embracing change.

April 2131.
In the deserted countryside, rally cars are racing endlessly to entertain the public far in the capital. Recruit, film, manage to make the races go as smoothly and spectacularly as possible. Everything should go well, as long as you keep everything under control…

A game made by Cal. With musics from Lorrain Castel.
Game trailer made in Da Vinci Resolve.
